description: Land Title Settlement Department - Sattambikulama, Nuwaragam Palatha East D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110198 (22/0784)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for multiple parcels in various villages. It contains detailed land particulars including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and encumbrances. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, focusing on land registrations, title determinations, and property ownership declarations without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
